description: Transportation Secure Data Center is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Jeff Gonder (National Renewable Energy Laboratory). The Transportation Secure Data Center (TSDC) at https//www.nrel.gov/tsdc provides free access to detailed transportation data from travel surveys and studies conducted across the nation. It features millions of data points including second-by-second GPS readings, vehicle characteristics, and demographics for all modes of travel.
